label: Holder
summary: The character who holds the holding.
details: Vanilla chains it with other character functions, for example to ask whether the holder is at war or has barter goods. The game's list gives no return type for it, so this rests on its name and those uses.

label: Illustration
summary: The picture that shows the holding.
details: Vanilla uses it as the texture of an image in the faith window and the holy site window. The game's list gives no return type, so this rests on its name and those uses.

label: Holding income
summary: The tax income the holding gives, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it after a gold icon in the realm window, the holding view and the title view, where the text calls it taxes.

label: Lessee or holder
summary: The character who leases the holding, or the holder if nobody leases it.
details: Rests on its name. Vanilla uses it only in a debug map tooltip, on a line labelled Holder, reached through the province's holding. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Levies tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains the levies a holding gives.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of an element in the county view, the ledger and the realm window. The game's list gives no return type, so this rests on its name and those uses.

label: Max garrison
summary: The largest garrison the holding can have, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it in a holding's garrison text as the second figure of 'current/maximum', after GetCurrentGarrisonSize.

label: Max levy size
summary: The most levy soldiers the holding can provide, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it after a soldier icon in the realm window and the holding view, and in the title view as the levies of a holding.

label: Holding name
summary: The name of the holding, as text.
details: Vanilla uses it in the government text that says a character's primary holding (with its type and province) does not fit a government.

label: Holding name, plain
summary: The name of the holding as text without the hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it as plain text in the shared tooltip window. Going by its name, it is the name without the tooltip that the full name carries.

label: Primary building type
summary: The main building type of the holding.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it, and the game's list gives no return type.

label: Province
summary: The province the holding stands in.
details: Vanilla follows it with the province's title to show the title, its holder or its lessee in the holding tooltip. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Special building type
summary: The special building (a point of interest) type of the holding.
details: Vanilla has no use of the Holding form itself, but journey activity texts reach it through a province's holding and then ask for its name, as a point of interest. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Tax tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains the tax a holding gives.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of an element in the county view, the ledger and the realm window. The game's list gives no return type, so this rests on its name and those uses.

label: Holding tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the holding.
details: Vanilla uses it as the text of the shared tooltip window.

label: Holding type
summary: The type of the holding (its kind of holding).
details: Vanilla asks the result for its name and its concept name, to show the holding type in tooltips and in the realm window.

label: Unraised levy ratio
summary: The share of the holding's levies that are not raised, as a fixed-point number.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it. A percent form exists next to it.

label: Unraised levy percent
summary: The share of the holding's levies that are not raised, as a percent number.
details: Vanilla uses it as the value of a progress bar in the county view. What 'unraised' means rests on the name.

label: Has building from chain
summary: Whether the holding has a building from the same chain as the given building.
details: Going by its name and the lines of the same name on other types. Vanilla passes it the building shown in a holy site window, and uses the answer to enable or dim that building and to pick the text.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The building whose chain is checked.

label: Has duchy building slot
summary: Whether the holding has a duchy building slot.
details: Vanilla uses it in the ledger to decide whether a part is shown.

label: Has great building slot
summary: Whether the holding has a great building slot.
details: Going by its name and bool return type. Vanilla's county view uses the same name on the holding view, not on this type.

label: Has special building slot
summary: Whether the holding has a special building slot.
details: Going by its name and bool return type. Vanilla's county view uses the same name on the holding view, not on this type.

label: Is under construction
summary: Whether the holding is being built or built up right now.
details: Vanilla uses it in the outliner (the side list of the HUD) to show or hide parts, once together with a check that the player is not nomadic.

label: Is empty
summary: Whether the holding is empty.
details: Vanilla uses it to show or hide parts of the county view and the faith window. The input does not say what counts as empty.

label: Is holding hovered
summary: Whether the mouse is over the holding, or over one of the county's non-capital holdings.
details: Going by its name. Vanilla uses it in the outliner to set a button's pressed look, together with whether the holding is selected.

label: Is hovered
summary: Whether the mouse is over the holding.
details: Going by its name and bool return type. The input shows no use on this type; other types use the same name for a hover check.

label: Is low control
summary: Whether the holding has low control.
details: Going by its name. Vanilla uses it in the map icon layer to show or hide a map icon. The game's list gives no return type, and the input does not say what counts as low.

label: Is selected
summary: Whether the holding is the one currently selected.
details: Vanilla uses it in the outliner and the realm window to show a holding as selected (shown or pressed look).

label: Show holding pins
summary: Takes one value and probably answers whether holding pins are shown on the map.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it, the game's list gives no return type, and the input does not say what its argument is.

label: Is valid for lessee or holder
summary: Whether the holding can be held by the character who leases or holds it.
details: Going by its name. Vanilla uses it in the county view, together with a not-empty check, to show an element when a non-empty holding is not valid for its lessee or holder.

label: Levy and tax hindered
summary: Whether the holding's levy and tax are reduced by a situation that can be fixed.
details: Going by its name. Vanilla uses it in the county view to show hint elements.

label: On mouse enter
summary: An action for the moment the mouse moves onto the holding's map icon.
details: Vanilla calls it from the on_start of map icon templates, next to OnMouseLeave. It returns nothing. What it does exactly is not shown in the input.

label: On mouse leave
summary: An action for the moment the mouse leaves the holding's map icon.
details: Vanilla calls it from the on_start of map icon templates, next to OnMouseEnter. It returns nothing. What it does exactly is not shown in the input.

label: Holding itself
summary: The holding itself, passed on as a value.
details: Vanilla compares it with the building item's own object to check whether they are the same.

label: Holding item (access)
summary: The holding item itself, given in a form that functions can reach into.
details: Going by its name. The same name on other types is used as an argument that hands the current widget on. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Barony
summary: The barony of the holding item.
details: Vanilla asks the result for its plain name to label a holding row in the realm window.

label: Buildings
summary: The buildings of the holding item, as a list for the GUI to repeat over.
details: Going by its name. The same name on the holding view and on a ledger item is used as the data source of a list. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Building under construction
summary: The building now being constructed in the holding.
details: Vanilla uses it in the realm window tooltip to show the name and the effects of the building being built.

label: Holding
summary: The holding that the item stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a row in the realm window and to take the holding's illustration.

label: Status text
summary: A text that tells the status of the holding item.
details: Vanilla uses it as text in the realm window. The input does not say which statuses exist.

label: Is realm capital
summary: Whether the holding is the capital of the realm.
details: Vanilla uses it in the realm window to show an element only for the capital holding.

label: On click
summary: An action that runs when the holding item is clicked.
details: Vanilla calls it from the onclick of rows in the realm window. It returns nothing. What it does exactly is not shown in the input.

label: Holding item itself
summary: The holding item itself, passed on as a value.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The same name on other types hands the object itself to another function.

label: Holding status (access)
summary: The holding status itself, given in a form that functions can reach into.
details: Going by its name. The same name on other types is used as an argument that hands the current widget on. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Epidemic
summary: The epidemic that affects the holding.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the county view, shown when the status is an epidemic. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Legend
summary: The legend attached to the holding.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the county view, shown when the status is a legend. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Men-at-arms origin
summary: The men-at-arms (MAA) item that has its origin in this holding.
details: Going by its name and its use as a data context in the county view. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Men-at-arms type origin
summary: The men-at-arms (MAA) type that has its origin in this holding.
details: Going by its name and its use as a data context in the county view. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Terrain type
summary: The terrain type the status is about.
details: Going by its name and its use as a data context in the county view. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Timed modifier
summary: The timed modifier the status is about.
details: Going by its name and its use as a data context in the county view. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Winter level
summary: The winter level of the status, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla compares it with 1, 2 and 3 in the county view to show a different element for each level.

label: Is epidemic
summary: Whether this status is an epidemic.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view to show the epidemic part.

label: Is legend
summary: Whether this status is a legend.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view to show the legend part.

label: Is men-at-arms origin
summary: Whether this status marks a men-at-arms regiment that comes from the holding.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view to show the matching part.

label: Is men-at-arms type origin
summary: Whether this status marks a men-at-arms type that comes from the holding.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view to show the matching part.

label: Is terrain type
summary: Whether this status is a terrain type.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view to show the terrain part. It takes no argument here, so it asks about the status kind, not about one named terrain.

label: Is timed modifier
summary: Whether this status is a timed modifier.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view to show the matching part.

label: Is winter level
summary: Whether this status is a winter level.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view to show the winter part; the level itself comes from GetWinterLevel.

label: Holding status itself
summary: The holding status itself, passed on as a value.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The same name on other types hands the object itself to another function.

label: Holding type (access)
summary: The holding type itself, given in a form that functions can reach into.
details: Going by its name. The same name on other types is used as an argument that hands the current widget on. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Custom text
summary: A text the game computes for the holding type under a given name.
details: Going by the same function on other types (for example a character's custom text, named in quotes). The input shows no use on the holding type itself.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the custom text to produce.

label: Concept name
summary: The holding type's name as a game concept, as text.
details: Vanilla's texts use it in holding tooltips and in front of the word holding, as in 'Your <type> holding'.

label: Key
summary: The holding type's script key, as text.
details: Going by its name. Other types use the same function to print the internal key of a thing, for example a building's key in a debug text.

label: Type name
summary: The display name of the holding type, as text.
details: Vanilla uses it through the holding's type, for example in the county view and in realm window rows.

label: Primary building type
summary: The main building type of the holding type.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it, and the game's list gives no return type.

label: Tab icon
summary: The icon that stands for the holding type on a tab.
details: Vanilla uses it as the texture of an image in the county view and the ledger. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Has parameter
summary: Whether the holding type has the named parameter.
details: Vanilla's county view asks it with 'no_buildings' on the holding's type, together with the special building slot check. Other types use the same function with their own parameter names.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The parameter name to look for.
fields.values: a text in quotes, such as 'no_buildings'

label: Has tab icon
summary: Whether the holding type has a tab icon.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it, and the game's list gives no return type.

label: Holding type itself
summary: The holding type itself, passed on as a value.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The same name on other types hands the object itself to another function.

label: Holding type item (access)
summary: The holding type item itself, given in a form that functions can reach into.
details: Going by its name. The same name on other types is used as an argument that hands the current widget on. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Can construct building
summary: Whether the building of this item can be constructed.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view to enable a button and to show or hide parts.

label: Building
summary: The building that belongs to this holding type item.
details: Vanilla asks the building for its illustration for a province in the county view.

label: Holding type
summary: The holding type this item stands for.
details: Vanilla uses its name as text in the county view and in the 'wrong type of holding' tooltip.

label: Province
summary: The province this item is about.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the county view.

label: Tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of this holding type item.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of an element in the county view.

label: Wrong holding info
summary: Text that tells which characters cannot hold this holding type well.
details: Vanilla uses it in the 'wrong type of holding' tooltip of the holding selection view.

label: Is valid for player
summary: Whether this holding type is valid for the player.
details: Vanilla uses its negation in the county view to show an element when this is false. The input does not give the rules.

label: On click
summary: An action that runs when the holding type item is clicked.
details: Vanilla calls it from the onclick of an element in the county view. It returns nothing. What it does exactly is not shown in the input.

label: Holding type item itself
summary: The holding type item itself, passed on as a value.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The same name on other types hands the object itself to another function.

label: County breakdowns
summary: The county's breakdowns (the lists of what adds up to a figure), given for use as a data context.
details: Going by its name and its use as a data context in the county view. The game's list gives no return type.

label: County fertility bar
summary: The county's fertility bar, given for use as a data context.
details: Going by its name and its single use as a data context in the county view. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Plague resistance breakdown
summary: The breakdown of the county's plague resistance, given for use as a data context.
details: Going by its name and its single use as a data context in the county view. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Holding view (access)
summary: The holding view itself, given in a form that functions can reach into.
details: Going by its name. The same name on other types is used as an argument that hands the current widget on. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Can cancel construction
summary: Whether the construction going on in the holding can be cancelled.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the cancel button of the holding construction in the county view.

label: Can go to next county
summary: Whether there is a next county to move on to.
details: Vanilla uses it to enable the next-county button of the county view.

label: Can grant title
summary: Whether the title can be granted from the holding view.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Can build new holding
summary: Whether a new holding can be built in the province.
details: Vanilla uses it with a check that no holding type is being chosen at the moment, to enable the 'construct holding' button of the county view.

label: Can set county capital
summary: Whether the holding can be made the capital of its county.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view to show the move-capital element, once together with the realm capital check.

label: Can set realm capital
summary: Whether the holding can be made the capital of the realm.
details: Vanilla uses it to enable the matching button in the county view.

label: Cancel holding construction
summary: An action that cancels the holding being built.
details: Vanilla calls it from the onclick of the 'Abort ... Construction' button of the county view. It returns nothing.

label: Close
summary: An action that closes the holding view.
details: Vanilla calls it from the onclick of the close button in the county view. It returns nothing.

label: Close holding construction
summary: An action that closes the holding construction part of the view.
details: Vanilla calls it from the onclick of a button in the county view. It returns nothing.

label: Close subwindows
summary: An action that closes the sub-windows of the holding view.
details: Vanilla calls it from several onclick handlers in the county view. It returns nothing.

label: Faction names
summary: The names of all factions the county is in, as text.
details: Vanilla uses it in the tooltip 'In ... faction against me!' of the county view.

label: Buildings
summary: The buildings of the holding view, as a list for the GUI to repeat over.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list in the county view and to count its entries for tab shortcuts. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Construction progress
summary: How far construction in the given building slot has come, as a number.
details: Vanilla uses it as the value of a progress bar in the county view and passes 0 (written '(int32)0') as the slot.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The building slot number; vanilla passes 0.

label: Construction time left
summary: The time left to finish construction in the given building slot, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it as text and passes 0 (written '(int32)0') as the slot.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The building slot number; vanilla passes 0.

label: County holdings
summary: The holdings of the county, as a list for the GUI to repeat over.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list in the county view. The game's list gives no return type.

label: County modifiers
summary: The modifiers on the county, as a list for the GUI to repeat over.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list in the county view. The game's list gives no return type.

label: County opinion
summary: The county's opinion figure, as a whole number.
details: Going by its name. The ledger uses the same name on a county item and shows it with a sign format.

label: County title
summary: The title of the county.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context, for the county's name in capitals, and to ask whether the player can customize the title. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Current garrison size
summary: The size of the garrison now in the holding, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the county view.

label: De jure lieges
summary: The de jure lieges of the county, as a list for the GUI to repeat over.
details: Going by its name and its use as a data source in the county view. De jure means by the rightful map of titles, not by who holds what now. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Direct holder
summary: The character who directly holds the holding.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it, and the game's list gives no return type.

label: Faction
summary: The faction the holding view is about.
details: Going by its name only. The input shows no use on this type; a faction item and a title use the same name for a faction. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Duchy capital building
summary: The duchy capital building of the holding, as a building item for the GUI.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the duchy capital building slot in the county view.

label: Great building
summary: The great building of the holding, as a building item for the GUI.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the great building slot in the county view.

label: Holding building
summary: The holding's own building, as a building item for the GUI.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the holding building slot in the county view.

label: Special building
summary: The special building of the holding, as a building item for the GUI.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the special building slot in the county view.

label: Garrison ratio
summary: How full the garrison is, as a decimal number.
details: Vanilla uses it as the value of a progress bar in the county view. The input does not say whether 1 means full.

label: Garrison tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains the garrison.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of the garrison element in the county view.

label: Grant title tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for granting the title.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Holder
summary: The character who holds the holding shown in the view.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the county view, so the elements below can show that character. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Holder effects from buildings
summary: A text that lists what the holding's buildings do for the holder.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Holder modifier from buildings
summary: The value of one modifier that the holding's buildings give the holder, as a number.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it, and the input does not say what its argument is (probably which modifier).

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by the name, which modifier to read.

label: Holding
summary: The holding shown in the view.
details: Vanilla chains it with holding functions, for example the barter goods income, the type being constructed and the holding's type. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Holding building
summary: The holding's own building.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use this form; a separate GetGUIHoldingBuilding gives the building item the county view uses. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Holding construction tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains the holding construction.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the county view.

label: Holding description
summary: The description of the holding, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it as a text in the county view.

label: Holding statuses
summary: The statuses of the holding (epidemic, legend, winter, terrain and similar), as a list for the GUI to repeat over.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list in the county view; the entries are holding status items. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Holding type items
summary: The holding types that can be chosen, as a list for the GUI to repeat over.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list in the county view. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Under construction tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for a holding that is being built.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the county view.

label: Occupied info
summary: Text that tells whether and by whom the county is occupied.
details: Going by its name. Vanilla shows it as a text in the county view.

label: Potential buildings
summary: The buildings that could be built, as a list for the GUI to repeat over.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a list in the county view, and tests whether it is empty to show a different element. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Province
summary: The province of the holding shown in the view.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the county view, and its title in the 'move county capital here' and 'cancel construction' tooltips. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Set realm capital tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for making the holding the realm capital.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the county view.

label: Supply limit
summary: The supply limit of the county, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the county view.

label: Supply limit tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains the supply limit.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the county view.

label: Title
summary: The title that goes with the holding shown in the view.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the county view, and checks its holder against the player and whether it is leased out. Which tier of title it is rests on the name only. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Top liege
summary: The highest liege above the holding, at the top of the realm.
details: Going by its name and the same name on other types. The input shows no use on this type. The game's list gives no return type.

label: Track
summary: The track shown in the holding view, as a track item for the GUI.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context in the county view. What the track is is not shown in the input.

label: Tracks label
summary: The label text of the tracks part of the view.
details: Vanilla shows it as a text in the county view.

label: Tracks prompt
summary: The prompt text of the tracks part of the view.
details: Vanilla shows it as a text in the county view.

label: Go to location
summary: An action that moves the map camera to the holding.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it. It returns nothing.

label: Go to next county
summary: An action that opens the view of the next county.
details: Vanilla calls it from the onclick of the next-county button of the county view. It returns nothing.

label: Has control of holding
summary: Whether control of the holding given to it is held.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it, and the input does not say what its argument is or who has the control.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by the name, a holding.

label: Has direct holder
summary: Whether the holding has a direct holder.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Has duchy capital slot
summary: Whether the holding has a duchy capital building slot.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view to show the matching part, alone and together with the special and great slot checks.

label: Has great building slot
summary: Whether the holding has a great building slot.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view to show the matching part, alone and together with the other slot checks.

label: Has holder
summary: Whether the holding has a holder.
details: Going by its name. The input shows no use on this type; a title uses the same name to ask whether a title has a holder.

label: Has holding
summary: Whether the province has a holding.
details: Vanilla uses it, and its negation, in the county view to show either the holding or an empty-slot part.

label: Has special building slot
summary: Whether the holding has a special building slot.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view, alone, with the other slot checks, and together with a check that the holding's type has the 'no_buildings' parameter.

label: Has top liege
summary: Whether the holding has a top liege above it.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it.

label: Is being constructed
summary: Whether a holding is currently being built here.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view, with a no-holding check, to tell an empty slot from one under construction.

label: Is in faction
summary: Whether the county is in a faction.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the 'in faction' button of the county view; the tooltip text of that warning names the factions with GetAllFactionNames.

label: Is choosing building
summary: Whether the player is choosing a building to construct.
details: Vanilla uses it, and its negation, in the county view to switch between the normal view and the building choice.

label: Is choosing holding type
summary: Whether the player is choosing a holding type.
details: Vanilla uses its negation to enable the build button of the county view only when no choice is open.

label: Is choosing new building
summary: Whether the player is choosing a new building.
details: Vanilla uses it in the county view to show the building choice. The difference to IsSelectingBuildingToConstruct is not explained in the input.

label: Next holding
summary: An action that moves on to the next holding.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it. It returns nothing.

label: On click holding building
summary: An action for a click on the holding's building.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it. It returns nothing.

label: On click cancel building
summary: An action for a click on the button that cancels the holding's building.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla does not use it. It returns nothing.
